clue.text: Mammal after insect, one of two on the field?

definitions.text: one of two on the field?

indicators.note: a thing placed after another comes second, so the mammal's word follows the insect's

blocks.note: a chirping insect
the flying mammal

explanation.surface: A naturalist spots a mammal following an insect, perhaps in a meadow.
explanation.walkthrough: 'after' places the mammal behind the insect. Cricket is England's summer bat-and-ball game; two batsmen are on the field at once, each holding one.
explanation.definitionFit: In cricket two batsmen are in at a time, so two of these implements are on the field together.
